supported_conclusion: Adverse evidence deserves investigation before advice.
unsupported_extension: A numerical placement estimate from these interviews.
strengthening_evidence: Trace upstream cohorts and measure definitions.
weakening_or_limiting_evidence: Different outcomes under defined programmes or periods.

supported_conclusion: The paper can identify reported patterns in its sample.
strengthening_evidence: Protocols, coded records and explicit comparison groups.
weakening_or_limiting_evidence: Selection, prompting, attrition and unobserved departures.

supported_conclusion: Retain figures as assertions with unresolved denominator.
strengthening_evidence: Dated instrument, cohort, response count and destination definitions.
weakening_or_limiting_evidence: Unknown coverage and mixed destination categories.

supported_conclusion: Both favorable and adverse interpretations were recorded.
unsupported_extension: Direct quotations, validated employer beliefs or actual offers.
strengthening_evidence: Transcript-to-code trail and separately observed employer practices.
weakening_or_limiting_evidence: A participant's concrete hiring claim may be incorrect.

supported_conclusion: An occupational aim need not exhaust a student's reasons.
unsupported_extension: Those reasons establish financial value or erase unmet aims.
strengthening_evidence: Student-defined goals paired with costs and subsequent outcomes.
weakening_or_limiting_evidence: Prestige expectations may fail to convert into opportunities.

unsupported_extension: Reframing has been shown to improve hiring.
strengthening_evidence: Comparison with explicit measured job-search outcomes.
weakening_or_limiting_evidence: Equivalent outcomes or worsened information quality after reframing.

supported_conclusion: Missing conversion evidence remains a research and advising obligation.
unsupported_extension: No graduate can obtain work or every officer deliberately deceived applicants.
strengthening_evidence: Dated disclosure records and independent degree-to-job evidence.
weakening_or_limiting_evidence: Contrary cases narrow universals without settling typical outcomes.
